question: How many new Khelo India Centres are planned by the Delhi Government in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 new Khelo India Centres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Delhi Government** has announced the establishment of **6 new Khelo India Centres** in 2025 to promote sports and nurture young talent in the region.
 
• The initiative is part of the **Khelo India Scheme**, a flagship program by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports aimed at **revitalizing the sports culture** in India at the grassroots level.
 
• These centres will focus on identifying and training athletes in various disciplines, ensuring access to **quality infrastructure, coaching, and resources**.
 
• The centres are expected to cater to **young athletes**, providing them with opportunities to excel in national and international competitions.
 
• They will also align with the government's commitment to enhancing **sports infrastructure** and fostering youth engagement in sports activities across Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Scheme:**

 
 
• **Launched in 2018**, the Khelo India Scheme aims to **develop sports infrastructure**, identify talent, and provide financial assistance to athletes.
 
• It covers various components such as **Talent Identification and Development**, **Sports for Women**, **Promotion of Rural and Indigenous Games**, and **Sports for Peace and Development**.
 
• The scheme also organizes the **Khelo India Youth Games** and **Khelo India University Games** to provide young athletes with a competitive platform.
 
 
 
• **Existing Sports Infrastructure in Delhi:**
 
 
• Delhi is home to several prominent sporting facilities, including the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium**, and **Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium**.
 
• The establishment of new Khelo India Centres will further **enhance sports accessibility** and bridge the gap between aspiring athletes and professional training.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India Centres:**
 
 
• The centres will provide a **structured pathway** for young athletes to transition from grassroots to elite-level sports.
 
• They will also contribute to **community engagement** by encouraging local participation and fostering a culture of fitness and sportsmanship.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Government's Initiatives in Sports:**
 
 
• The Delhi Government has been actively promoting sports through initiatives like **Mission Excellence**, which provides financial support to athletes.
 
• The new Khelo India Centres will complement these efforts, ensuring a holistic approach to sports development in the region.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games:**

 
 
• These games are organized annually and serve as a platform for young athletes to **showcase their talent**.
 
• The games include a wide range of sporting disciplines such as athletics, archery, basketball, boxing, football, gymnastics, judo, swimming, and more.
 
• The 2023 edition of the games was hosted in **Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh**.
 
 
 
• **Indigenous Sports Promotion:**
 
 
• As part of the Khelo India initiative, indigenous sports like **Kabaddi**, **Kalaripayattu**, **Kho-Kho**, and **Mallakhamb** are being promoted to preserve and popularize traditional games.
 
• This ensures the inclusivity and cultural representation of sports across India.
